policy: Statuses reflect implementation and local evidence, not complete site coverage. Close a gap only with its acceptance evidence.

gaps.implemented: Full profile extracts interacted top-document markup, used CSS and asset inventory from the existing page, without duplicate navigation.
gaps.remaining: Separate COPY remains available for broader sweeps; same-state extraction covers current viewport/top document only.
gaps.acceptance: Extract the intended authenticated/interacted state without navigation or duplicate interaction passes.

gaps.implemented: Burp startup/MCP verified after Java harness fix. NBRET HTTP and HTTPS fixture responses independently matched in Burp history; changed-input local MCP request7+3 returned10. Strict process-scoped CA trust verified against Burp: missing CA rejects, supplied CA verifies hostname/chain and result25.
gaps.remaining: Chromium normal trust verified once through a temporary Windows Current User root (2026-10-14, Kotaro-approved, both Windows prompts confirmed by Kotaro); the certificate was removed and absence re-checked in Current User and Local Machine Root. Repeat runs need fresh approval.
gaps.acceptance: Match a local request and response across NBRET and Burp history; preserve receipt without changing saved settings.

gaps.implemented: Independent worker, service-worker and cross-process frame network/script evidence merges into analysis, contracts and comparisons.
gaps.remaining: Up to20 targets, per-target budgets; child-frame DOM and short-lived lifecycle coverage remain limited.
gaps.acceptance: Worker/OOPIF fixtures preserve their request, script and action/state evidence with target IDs.

gaps.implemented: Scoped cookie/localStorage export/import uses fresh owned contexts; login reuse, same-state extraction and reset verified.
gaps.remaining: sessionStorage and IndexedDB are not exported; session files contain credentials and stay local.
gaps.acceptance: Owned isolated sessions can be reused and reset with documented state/provenance; unrelated accounts remain untouched.

gaps.implemented: Ordered structured WebSocket/SSE comparison detects changed messages and missing connections.
gaps.remaining: Binary/unstructured payloads omitted; no general streaming protocol replay.
gaps.acceptance: Replayable local stream scenarios compare message order, shapes and state changes; omissions remain explicit.

gaps.implemented: Bounded motion trajectories detect timing/path defects; mobile viewport and reduced-motion fixtures verified.
gaps.remaining: Deterministic seeking is loopback-only; canvas and arbitrary JS animation recovery remain unsupported.
gaps.acceptance: Controlled animation fixture detects timing/path defects at matched viewports with reduced-motion coverage.

gaps.implemented: Multi-run observed shape alternatives and missing-field counts; explicit comparison origin aliases.
gaps.remaining: Observed shapes do not establish required fields or comprehensive backend schemas.
gaps.acceptance: Multiple input/error cases yield traceable shape alternatives without inventing required fields or server internals.

gaps.implemented: Same-state full pass avoids duplicate navigation; integrity-checked analysis and content-addressed asset reuse; measured profile costs. Three repeated fresh-capture profile samples verified calculation25; two fresh captures verified asset reuse without skipping live observation. Requirement-aware offline advisor uses repeated profile medians only among profiles meeting every requested evidence capability. Four public MDN desktop/mobile captures verify content and retain repeat differences; missing-body reason differences are separated from behavior.
gaps.remaining: Broader authenticated real-app corpus still requires owned targets and representative scenarios; fixture medians are not general performance predictions.
gaps.acceptance: Benchmark reports show saved work and storage with identical required observations; cached artifacts never masquerade as fresh captures.

gaps.implemented: Isolated mitmproxy12.2.3 and portable ZAP2.17.0 record local NBRET HTTP calculation and same-state COPY; product histories independently match result25. Dedicated lifecycle/receipt verification stops owned processes. ZAP silent/safe minimal installation uses only network and mandatory callhome addons.
gaps.remaining: Product-specific HTTPS/browser trust and richer failure/substitution experiments can expand when required; no active scanning or spidering is implemented.
gaps.acceptance: Add an adapter only for an unresolved experiment; declare scope, side effects, versions, budgets and a local fixture receipt.

gaps.implemented: Artifact review inventory classifies sensitive/raw/structured data with hashes and exports no captured contents by default.
gaps.remaining: No universal secret detection; even manifest paths and structured records require review before sharing.
gaps.acceptance: Explicit artifact classes and export review support preserve provenance while reducing accidental secret sharing.
